newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash maize steady before USDA figures.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash maize steady before USDA figures.

text.p: Argentine cash April maize was steady in slow trade Thursday at Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange as the market awaited Friday's USDA figures, traders said.

New crop cash soybeans rose in tight trade, with some speculating that the report may prove bullish for beans. Cash March sunflower seed rose, with sellers scarce. Cash January wheat firmed in slow trade, with exporters taking positions before the crop figures.
